topic: Revised withholding tax table for compensation (daily, weekly, semi-monthly, monthly)

source.issuance: BIR Revenue Regulations No. 11-2018, Annex E, effective January 1, 2023 and onwards (TRAIN law, RA 10963)
source.verified: 2026-10-29: read from the BIR-hosted PDF. The PDF text layer scrambles the column order, so every row was matched to its bracket by position and then checked arithmetically: each fixed tax equals the fixed tax of the bracket below plus its rate times the bracket width (see test/annex.test.js).
source.note: The daily 6th bracket prints as 'P 6,034.00.30' in the text layer; 6,034.30 is what the arithmetic gives (1,102.60 + 30% x 16,439) and what the BIR table shows.

notes: Each row: tax = base_tax + rate x (income - of_excess_over). `over` is the lower bound of the bracket and `not_over` its printed upper bound; an income belongs to the last bracket whose lower bound it reaches. Employees at or below the first bracket's ceiling are exempt. These tables replace the whole-peso-rounded fixed taxes in the open-payroll-data copy (for example 8,542 where the BIR prints 8,541.80).
